title: Discussing the Trade-Offs Between Using a Larger Model for Deployments

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we saved our best performing model, which was a pre-trained model that we adjusted the classifier head to work on our own problem.
cues.zh: 上支影片，儲存了表現最好的模型，也就是把分類頭改成自己問題的預訓練模型。

cues.en: And we checked out its model size and we found that its 327 megabytes, which may be a little bit big
cues.zh: 檢查檔案大小，是 327 MB。若要把 FoodVision Mini 做成正式產品，

cues.en: if we were to, wanted to deploy it to a mobile application or a web browser, if we were building Food Vision Mini as a production application.
cues.zh: 部署手機或瀏覽器，可能有點大。

cues.en: And so in the last video, I said there's a challenge to compare it to the model that we trained in section seven Efficient Net B2, which was 29 megabytes.
cues.zh: 上支影片留了挑戰，和第七節的 EfficientNet-B2 比，它是 29 MB。

cues.en: Then if we look at the values that they got on the different data sets and there's a little note here that yes, the efficient net B2 feature extracted from the last section was trained on 20% of the pizza,
cues.zh: 比較不同資料集結果時，這裡提醒，上一節的 EfficientNet-B2 特徵擷取模型，用了 pizza、

cues.en: steak and sushi data.
cues.zh: steak、sushi 資料的 20%。

cues.en: So to compare apples to apples, we would have to retrain this on 20% of the pizza steak and sushi data.
cues.zh: 所以要公平比較，這裡的 ViT 也得用 20% 資料重訓。

cues.en: So that's an exercise or an extension that I've got down here and exercises.
cues.zh: 這是練習區留下的延伸。

cues.en: But if we compare this.
cues.zh: 但如果比較，

cues.en: Is it worth it?
cues.zh: 值得嗎？

cues.en: That's the main question.
cues.zh: 這是主要問題。

cues.en: If we were looking to get the best performance, the feature extractor model is about over 11 times or about 11 times bigger than the efficient net B two feature extractor.
cues.zh: 想取得最佳效能，這個 ViT 特徵擷取模型，比 EfficientNet-B2 大約大十一倍，

cues.en: But the test accuracy performance is roughly the same in terms of the best results.
cues.zh: 但最佳測試準確率大致相近。

cues.en: So I'm taking the best one here.
cues.zh: 這裡取最好的那次，
原字幕連成「9384」，精確小數分隔尚未確認。

cues.en: If we were to save that one.
cues.zh: 如果儲存的是那次模型，

cues.en: The only real difference is that the feature extractor has a slightly lower test lost value.
cues.zh: 真正差別只在 ViT 特徵擷取模型，測試損失略低。

cues.en: Now, this is something you're going to have to think about when you go to deploy your models.
cues.zh: 部署模型時，就必須思考。

cues.en: Is that is the bigger model?
cues.zh: 這個更大的模型，

cues.en: Remember, generally in deep learning, the bigger the better.
cues.zh: 記得，講者說深度學習通常越大越好，

cues.en: But if you have compute restraints, is the bigger model worth trying to get it into production versus the smaller model?
cues.zh: 但運算受限時，和小模型相比，大模型值得部署到正式環境嗎？

cues.en: So this is only something that's going to come with practice, but it's just something to think about.
cues.zh: 這需要經驗，只是先讓你想想。

cues.en: We're going to cover more concepts about model deployment in the next section, which is not here yet, but it'll be high touch model deployment.
cues.zh: 下一節會談更多部署概念，這裡還沒列出，會叫 PyTorch Model Deployment。

cues.en: But that's just something to check.
cues.zh: 但這是值得檢查的。

cues.en: So if you're getting good results with a model that's 11 times smaller than another model, potentially, it may be more worth deploying this.
cues.zh: 小十一倍的模型，如果已有好結果，可能更值得部署。

cues.en: So the example Nutrafol app, this is application I'm working on is using very similar techniques to Food Vision Mini.
cues.zh: 例如我正在做的食物應用程式，名稱原字幕辨識為 Nutrafol，技術和 FoodVision Mini 很像。

cues.en: And if we upload an image, if we go zero for Pizza Dad, which is the custom image we've been using, upload that.
cues.zh: 上傳影像，使用一直用的自訂影像 04-pizza-dad，把它上傳。

cues.en: So this model runs in the browser.
cues.zh: 模型在瀏覽器裡執行。

cues.en: Now there's no GPU powering this.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有 GPU。

cues.en: So if we wanted to compute on this image and predicted food, pizza and there's the macronutrients for the average pizza, it went pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 計算影像後，預測是 pizza，再顯示一般披薩的主要營養素，速度很快。

cues.en: So something you'll have to think about is that will a model that size 327 megabytes take longer to
cues.zh: 需要思考，327 MB 的模型，

cues.en: compute and provide a good experience for someone using it versus a smaller model that gets roughly the same results but is almost instantaneous.
cues.zh: 和結果差不多、幾乎立即完成的小模型相比，是否要計算更久，使用體驗如何。

cues.en: Just something to think about for going on for when you deploy your models and build machine learning powered applications.
cues.zh: 這是未來部署模型、打造機器學習應用程式時，要考慮的事。

cues.en: But with that being said, let's finish off this section and replicate what we've done here, but with our PRE-TRAINED model.
cues.zh: 接下來，完成這一節，把之前做過的流程，換成預訓練模型重做。

cues.en: So we've done this a few times now.
cues.zh: 已經做過幾次，

cues.en: That is section 11 predicting on a custom image.
cues.zh: 就是第十一節，預測自訂影像。

cues.en: So give that a shot.
cues.zh: 試試。

cues.en: We've covered that in the previous section as well.
cues.zh: 上一節也做過。

cues.en: But this time, instead of using the efficient net V two or B two model, use the pre trained feature extractor that we just trained.
cues.zh: 但這次不要用 EfficientNet-B2，而是剛訓練的預訓練特徵擷取模型。

cues.en: Give that a shot and I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 試試，下支影片見。
